lines.ruling: Ruling: representation (+ scope); as the earlier rulings of this disagreement. i8889 p. 7, Line 6, Step 1, and p. 4, Line 3, rule 2 (amb.2025.hsa_last_month_all_year, reading 1). Step 1 is read only on the married allocation path (f8889.line6_split under f8889.split), so it reaches no printed line elsewhere; the reply returns zero when the spouse rule does not apply (split false), the project's helper keeps the Step 1 figure. Triage of this reply (triage.py, 1,641 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 494 partial records): 1,177 of 1,438 agree; on completed returns 14 value differences (every witness shown has split false, Step 1 not read) and 11 project-unknown (f8889.last_month unanswered where Step 1 is not read); the printed lines 3, 6, 7, 13, 16 and 17b show no completed-return value difference.

Ruling: representation (+ model error on the allocation check); as the earlier ruling. i8889 p. 7, Line 6, Step 2: divide Step 1 'equally between you and your spouse unless you both agree on a different allocation'. The helper is read only under f8889.split; the reply returns zero when split is false and, as before, leaves the check of an agreed allocation to the household totals, where the project tests it (f8889.allocation_bad). Triage of this reply: 900 of 1,438 agree; on completed returns 10 value differences (every witness shown has split false), 83 project-unknown (the allocation answers where split is false) and 4 candidate-refuses; value differences elsewhere only on incomplete or refused records; no difference on a printed line of completed returns.

Ruling: representation; Form 8889 (2025), line 6, and i8889 p. 4, Line 3, rules 1 to 3; as the earlier rulings. Triage of this reply: 1,435 of 1,438 agree; the 3 differences are project-unknown on refused records; no completed-return difference.

Ruling: reading recorded (amb.2025.hsa_last_month_change); project retained (owner ruling, T-033: keep rule 4); as the earlier ruling. The reply applies rule 2 to every last-month-rule filer and rule 4's greater-of only to a filer eligible all twelve months; the project applies rule 4 also to a last-month-rule filer who changed coverage type. Triage of this reply: 1,355 of 1,438 agree; no completed-return difference; the differences are on incomplete records (30 candidate-unknown, 10 project-unknown, 1 value) and refused records (17 candidate-refuses, 13 candidate-unknown, 10 project-unknown, 2 value).

Ruling: ambiguity and scope; as the earlier rulings. i8889 p. 7, Line 6, Steps 1 to 4 (amb.2025.hsa_step4_other_limits, owner reading 1; amb.2025.hsa_last_month_all_year). Triage of this reply: 1,340 of 1,438 agree; on completed returns only the reply's own refusals (2, h_alloc_over, 'Outside candidate scope'); value differences only on incomplete (3) and refused (6) records.

Ruling: scope; project retained; as the earlier ruling. Line 7 applies only to a married filer, and married filers are refused (f8889.married); for an unmarried filer age 55 or older the $1,000 is in line 3 (rule 6). Triage of this reply: 1,423 of 1,438 agree; no completed-return difference; the 15 differences are project-unknown or value on incomplete (4) and refused (11) records.

Ruling: equivalent; project retained. i8889 p. 8, line 13: the smaller of line 2 or line 12. The reply returns zero when line 2 is zero and the smaller of lines 12 and 2 otherwise; the project also reads line 9 before returning zero, but line 2 is never negative (NonNegDollars), so the smaller of line 12 and line 2 is zero when line 2 is zero and the two agree wherever both are defined. The project-unknown differences (25, incomplete records) are records with no answer for line 9, which the reply never needs; on completed returns only the reply's own refusals differ (2, h_alloc_over). Triage of this reply: 1,362 of 1,438 agree; 32 project-refuses and 2 value on refused records.

Ruling: equivalent; project retained. i8889 p. 8, Line 16: line 14c less line 15, not below zero. The project returns zero without distributions (line 14a zero); with line 14a zero, line 14c is zero (f8889.rollover_bad refuses a line 14b above line 14a), so the reply's subtraction gives the same value. Triage of this reply: 1,437 of 1,438 agree; the one difference is the reply's own refusal on an incomplete record.
